welcomeIntro: Shown automatically as a message from you the first time a new member opens the community. Each person sees it only once — leaving and rejoining won't show it again. Only people who join after you turn it on will see it.
welcomeHint: Use {ten} for the member's name and {cong_dong} for the community name. Line breaks, "- " bullets, **bold** and /page or https://… links are rendered nicely.
welcomePlaceholder:
Hi {ten}, welcome to {cong_dong}! 👋

To get started:
- Read the pinned post
- Introduce yourself
- Open the Classroom and start lesson 1
announceIntro: Publishing here posts an "Announcement" in the feed and pins it. Pinned "Announcement" posts (including ones you pin in the feed) pop up for members when they open this community's pages. Each person sees each announcement once; several show as slides from oldest to newest. New members only see the welcome message — not older announcements, only ones posted after they join.
annBodyHint: Line breaks, "- " bullets, **bold** and links are rendered nicely.
annLinkHint: A site path (starting with /) or https://…
publishHint: New announcements are added at the end; other pinned announcements stay.
